work_or_witness: Etrian Odyssey HD · About this item
canonical_term: Etrian Odyssey HD (Nintendo Switch, US English witness)
definition: The selected Nintendo Switch digital remaster of the first Etrian Odyssey title: released 1 June 2023, published by SEGA, developed by ATLUS and MUTAN, and listed with US English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish support.
cultural_caution: A precise platform/version/localization witness only. It does not establish that original Nintendo DS, other regional scripts, II HD, III HD, the multi-title collection, or later franchise entries have matching text, features, or canon details.

supports: Nintendo lists Switch platform, digital format, 1 June 2023 release, SEGA publisher, ATLUS/MUTAN developers, and supported languages.

work_or_witness: Etrian Odyssey HD · Create Endless Adventure
definition: The publisher-provided setup places a town named Etria beside a forest fissure leading into a labyrinth, and presents exploration of the Yggdrasil Labyrinth as the game's central mystery.
cultural_caution: Place and dungeon terms only. Neither Etria nor the labyrinth is a character endpoint, and this product-summary premise does not license importing later-floor revelations or sequel setting material.

supports: Publisher description identifies Etria, the forest fissure/labyrinth, and the Yggdrasil Labyrinth mystery.

work_or_witness: Create Endless Adventure; Etrian Odyssey HD Features
definition: The player builds an explorer party from nine character classes; the publisher gives woodland survivalist, shield-bearing protector, and whip-wielding dark hunter as examples.
cultural_caution: Classes are selectable game roles, not stable individuals. A class name, build, portrait, player-assigned name, or party composition must not be represented as a canonical dramatic person.

citations.locator: Create Endless Adventure; Etrian Odyssey HD Features
supports: Publisher description says players build a party from nine classes and choose classes to fit their playstyle.

definition: The Switch remaster offers touch-screen mapping in which players draw walls and place icons to record special events and resources, alongside a Monstrous Codex, quest log, and skill tree.
cultural_caution: Map notes, codex completion, quest logs, and skill choices are player/interface records, not independent sources of fixed narrative or character identity.

supports: Publisher description identifies touch-screen mapping, event/resource icons, Monstrous Codex, quest log, and skill tree.

work_or_witness: Create Endless Adventure; Etrian Odyssey HD Features
definition: Etrian Odyssey HD is described as a remaster with remastered graphics and soundtrack, quality-of-life improvements, difficulty selection, and save slots.
cultural_caution: A remaster/product boundary, not evidence that the original release and remaster have identical content. Difficulty, save files, party construction, and choices produce individual player states rather than shared canon.

citations.locator: Create Endless Adventure; Etrian Odyssey HD Features
supports: Publisher description calls the title a remaster and lists remastered presentation, quality-of-life improvements, difficulty selection, and save slots.

work_or_witness: SEGA Privacy Hub: Our Games · Our Games title list
definition: SEGA lists Etrian Odyssey HD, Etrian Odyssey II HD, and Etrian Odyssey III HD as distinct titles.
cultural_caution: Franchise-product taxonomy only. Do not transfer NPCs, maps, quests, class content, localized names, mechanics, or story facts among numbered titles simply because they are sold in a collection or use related branding.

supports: SEGA lists the three HD numbered titles separately.

definition: Nintendo lists an Etrian Odyssey HD Character Portrait DLC Set dated 14 June 2023 separately from the base digital game.
cultural_caution: A separate cosmetic/downloadable-content boundary. Portraits are player presentation options, not proof of a distinct named adventurer or a character's fixed visual canon.

supports: Nintendo lists a separate Character Portrait DLC Set for Etrian Odyssey HD.
